instruction: I'm concerned about privacy. Please disable the third-party cookies in Chrome for me.

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling third-party cookies in Chrome settings (chrome://settings/cookies). The evaluator reads the Default/Preferences file to check if 'profile.block_third_party_cookies' is set to true. Similar difficulty - navigating to privacy settings and changing one configuration option.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator correctly verifies the single requirement of disabling third-party cookies
Getter logic is correct: Reads Chrome preferences file from correct platform-specific paths and extracts 'profile.block_third_party_cookies' setting
Metric logic is correct: Performs exact boolean comparison (block_third_party == true), appropriate for this binary setting
Proper postconfig: Kills and relaunches Chrome to ensure preferences file is properly saved and readable
Expected value is semantically correct: block_third_party=true matches the instruction to 'disable third-party cookies'
Data flow is correct: Getter extracts the right setting, metric compares the right value, expected matches instruction
Edge cases handled: Getter has error handling with sensible defaults, metric checks for None/empty results
